verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I stand before You Lord
And give you all my praise

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your love is all that I need
Jesus You're all I need

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
My life belongs to You
You gave Your life for me

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Your grace is all that I need
Jesus You're all I need

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Hold me in Your arms, never let me go
I want spend eternity with You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Now that You're near, everything is different
Everything's so different, Lord

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I know I'm not the same
My life you've changed

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
I want to be with you
I want to be with you

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I will sing for you always
'Cause in Your presence Lord
Is where I want to stay
